text:
maya: live chat check — all-hands in full swing, who brought snacks? :popcorn:
sam: I have chips and an irrational amount of salsa. not sharing unless convened by raffle :taco:
devon: my dog is howling along to the applause, not a drill. 🐶👏
ashley: can we get a quick poll? pizza or bagels? :pizza: :bagel:
kevin: pizza. always pizza. +1 for extra olives (controversial) :olive:
leah: bagels for the early birds, pizza for the midnight coders. split-the-difference vote! :sleeping: :pizza:
ops-bot: Recording live chat reactions for the all-hands (meeting_id=AH-2026-03-23).
maya: love the energy. also sending a haiku chain? anyone else? i'll start:
maya: slides flash past / coffee pumps, snack hands reach outward / mute button is life
sam: beautiful, will continue —
sam: keyboard clacks softly / breakout rooms of distant snacks / applause travels slow
devon: @maya @sam okay time for my terrible one: 
devon: sync, slide, and laughter / pixel confetti on screens / someone order fries
ashley: :trophy: award for best snack haiku goes to devon for rhyme-adjacent excellence
kevin: raffle time? use `/raffle -n 3` in #random and we'll PM winners a $15 snack card. :gift_card:
leah: winners should also get a virtual sticker. i made a sparkler badge :sparkler: (file: sparkler-badge.png)
maya: stickers + snack card = peak startup morale. also shoutout to product for the demo, that was smooth :clap:
sam: gif dump time — https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-dance-3o6gE5aYfqtQWQZ5sG :dancer:
ops-bot: Note: Meeting captioning enabled. Transcripts will be available in ~10min.
devon: quick logistic q — is the rooftop snack fridge restocked? i will literally sprint if yes :running_man:
ashley: yes! restocked at 1pm. someone left a Post-it that said "do not eat Gary's kale" so proceed with caution :warning:
kevin: @devon i can meet you by the elevator, bring a bag for shared victory :handshake:
leah: also, poll for next all-hands vibe: acoustic set vs. DJ vs. silent disco? :notes:
maya: acoustic set. imagine campfire ukulele but less camping :guitar:
sam: silent disco for the extroverts who love headphones :headphones:
ops-bot: Reminder: next week's all-hands topic nominations now open via the form in #announcements.
maya: ok back to the auditorium — more haikus encouraged, snack runners assemble, and good vibes only :sparkles:
